info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Gateway Integration API
info.description: The Operational Gateway Integration API facilitates the seamless management and integration of banking IT operations. By leveraging this API, clients can effectively manage and monitor operational data related to their banking infrastructure. Typical use cases involve automating IT workflows, enhancing system interoperability, and optimizing resource allocation. This API is designed for developers and IT teams seeking to improve operational efficiencies within financial institutions.

post.description: This endpoint allows developers to create a new operational gateway within the IT management system. It accepts the necessary parameters to configure the gateway and returns a confirmation of its creation.
